'''Gindo''' was a [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]], who acted as a double for [[Enni Anni]], a member of the band [[Distraction]]. As part of a security ploy, he was escorted off the ''[[Sleemo Poya Jeedai]]'' by [[Xydge]], along with doubles of the other band members.
